title: Move debug logs in `.tailwindcss` folder
body: Instead of writing debug logs (triggered by using `DEBUG=*`) in the root of the project as `tailwindcss-.log`, we will write them to `.tailwindcss/logs/scanner--.log` instead. The reasoning for this is that we won't pollute the root of the project. Another reason is that if you don't ignore `.log` files via `.gitignore`, it could be that you end up in a loop if you use `DEBUG=* vite` because a new `.log` file might trigger a new build. We noticed this while looking at https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/discussions/20382. The `.tailwindcss` folder will come with a `.gitignore` file that ignores everything (`*`). ## Test plan 1. Nothing really changed here, all tests should pass Testing this in a local project, it looks like this:
